name: Loan Data 134
definition: Specifies the loan data details in case of a securities lending transaction.

ContractType.name: Contract Type
ContractType.definition: Identification of the type of the transaction.

Cleared.name: Cleared
Cleared.definition: Indicates that the contract has been cleared.

PortfolioCode.name: Portfolio Code
PortfolioCode.definition: Unique code determined by the reporting counterparty identifying the portfolio.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Identification of the trading venue where the transaction was executed.

MasterAgreementType.name: Master Agreement Type
MasterAgreementType.definition: Type of agreement expressed as a code set. Reference to the master agreement under which the counterparties concluded a documented transaction.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the closing leg (forward leg) of the secured financing transaction. This information shall not be reported for open term agreements.

GeneralCollateral.name: General Collateral
GeneralCollateral.definition: Indication whether the secured financing transaction is subject to a general or special collateral arrangement.

Term.name: Term
Term.definition: Period before or at the end of which the loan should be repaid or renegotiated for another term.

PriceCurrency.name: Price Currency
PriceCurrency.definition: Currency in which the the security or commodity price is denominated.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Data specific to securities being subject to the transaction.
